description.value: Saku is an authentic Japanese tonkatsu (pork cutlet) restaurant specializing in premium Canadian-raised hormone-free pork prepared in a variety of classic katsu styles. The Broadway location features an all-year-round heated patio seating 26 guests, making it a viable stop in any season. The menu spans pork, chicken, seafood, and vegetable katsu sets, all served with unlimited rice, tonjiru, and shredded cabbage.
